visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable views including the compact 1024×640 preview. Individual Muhammad Ali Mosque: cascading pale central, lower and corner dome roofs; warm masonry prayer hall; two slender pencil minarets and projecting balcony rings; an open round-arched court with small rooftop cupolas; mapped octagonal fountain canopy; green/brown clock pavilion with pale dials and a hipped roof. Moved lower-storey panes to the aggregate exterior instead of burying them behind it, removed the duplicate lower apse wall that covered six panes, added the missing clock-roof soffit so the pavilion posts meet the roof, and closed the inward faces of the fountain arch bands. The fountain canopy now follows its mapped eight-vertex outline and position. Balcony rails/posts are stylized at 20 cm minimum. Fine carving, painted canopy art, inscriptions, clock mechanism, exact paired column ornament and furnished interiors are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared-material/geographic-flat views and the north-up placement overlay. Six existing shared 256² limestone, raw limestone, standing-seam metal, marble, plain wood and cast-bronze graphs serve seven merged roles including local opaque blue-grey panes. Clock and fountain green use the same wood graph with linear vertex tints; surfaces have metric UVs and no embedded images or copied photographs. Every graph is read once, and eviction disposes the model geometry and restores the host ground. The retained anchor and heading remain unchanged; parent, twenty building parts and fountain are replaced while separate neighboring buildings remain. Flat placement verifies transforms and cutout bindings, not surveyed Citadel grade.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final medium-fi views and the matched skyline at full size: Economy/High, noon/late light, three distances, untextured silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. Skyline keeps the pale central/four lower domes, paired pencil minarets with projecting balconies, two small rear turret silhouettes, open court, fountain and clock pavilion. It omits the small corner caps, low eastern projection and arcade detail; these return from district onward. District restores sparse round fields and court cupolas, street restores denser arches, lower-storey panes and selected balcony detail, and closeup refines curves and bay rhythm. Coarser dome faceting, gallery density and solid far arcade walls are intentional distance changes. Synthetic Levantine stone neighbors and coarse standard-viewer DEM are fixtures. Physical phone/tablet/laptop measurements and full-city performance remain pending.
